definitions.explanation: A formal name for the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland. More formal than イギリス, commonly used in news, diplomacy, and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {英国|えいこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{英国|えいこく}⟦{大使館|たいしかん}→大使館：01457_taishikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

{英国|えいこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来日|らいにち}→来日：13060_rainichi⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{首脳|しゅのう}→首脳：15631_shunou⟧⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The British Prime Minister visited Japan and a summit meeting was held.

notes:
USAGE:
{英国|えいこく} is the formal, Sino-Japanese name for Britain. In everyday conversation, ⟦イギリス→イギリス：28283_igirisu⟧ is more common. {英国|えいこく} appears frequently in news reports, government documents, and academic writing. The character {英|えい} alone can function as an abbreviation for Britain, as in ⟦{日英|にちえい}→日英：24610_nichiei⟧ (Japan-Britain) or ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧ (English language).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {英国|えいこく}⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧: the British government
- {英国|えいこく}⟦{王室|おうしつ}→王室：15297_oushitsu⟧: the British royal family
- {英国|えいこく}{風|ふう}: British-style
